Name: Mysterious Postman Mod
Author: MOLINGBILI
Description: [b][i]This is the mysterious Postman Mod. Every day, at different times, a postman will bring different packages, including items, challenges, and some strange and peculiar things. You can accept it, or reject it, or you can ask the postman.[/i][/b]
